jobs.note: main20g rerun of atlas-8192-load-thing-8192. Config probe diagnostic: the probe now lists the ini files from EA config folder (registry local ini folder, EP11/Game/Bin on this Steam install), not Game/Bin. Queue.ts defaultIni still writes Game/Bin/Default.ini, which EA does not read here, so source none is expected and accepted in this rerun only; the rule wants the EP11 Default.ini named. [est 15 min] Thin 8192 m world with the uniform id grid, all three switches on, PortalFlagRefs as shipped (R7 left to the mod), Default.ini SceneQuadTree=8192,512,8. Pass: install lines as job 1, in_world, 2 min of camera poses, and a counters line with the 256 x 256 graph, rebuilt > 0, nothing above chunk 16,383 and fallback 0 (Atlas docs/010 I-010-2: every portal with a reference has its position set). A missing counters line means no Sim crossed a lot portal in the 2 min (not reached, rerun longer), not a patch failure. Kill criterion as P0: largest free under about 1.2 GB after the load.
